content.value_statement: Teams lose time when frontend, API, database, and deployment choices are handled separately. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through full-stack application planning and implementation.
actual_capabilities: Plans frontend and backend file structures for React, Next.js, and Node.js projects.
Designs REST or GraphQL APIs with validation, error handling, and typed data models.
Creates React component patterns with hooks, state management, loading states, and error states.
Advises on PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Redis, and related schema choices.
Provides setup, dependency, and deployment guidance for common web application stacks.
limitations: It does not inspect a live repository unless the agent is given repository access.
Generated implementation details still need project-specific review and tests.
Deployment guidance depends on the hosting provider, secrets model, and runtime constraints.
Database migrations should be checked before running against shared or production data.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Features
use_cases.description: Create a working feature plan that covers UI, API endpoints, validation, and database changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Web Architecture
use_cases.description: Define consistent folders, service boundaries, and data access patterns for a JavaScript or TypeScript web app.

use_cases.title: Prepare Implementation Tasks
use_cases.description: Turn a feature request into clear frontend, backend, testing, and deployment tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Feature Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a full-stack feature for [feature]. Include frontend screens, API endpoints, database changes, dependencies, and setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Typed API
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a TypeScript API for [domain]. Include routes, validation rules, data models, errors, and testing notes.

prompt_templates.title: Review App Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project structure and suggest improvements for React, Node.js, data access, security, and maintainability: [paste structure].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production rollout plan for [application]. Cover database migrations, authentication, environment variables, CI checks, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.

output_examples.input: Create a simple blog post API.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a feature outline with route behavior, validation rules, database model notes, dependencies, and setup steps.

output_examples.input: Build a user profile page that loads API data.
output: A suggested component structure with loading and error states.
A matching API endpoint plan and data model summary.
Notes for tests, accessibility, and deployment readiness.

output_examples.input: Review my full-stack app architecture before launch.
output_examples.output: The skill returns practical review notes for frontend structure, backend boundaries, database access, security checks, and operational risks.

best_practices: Provide framework, database, hosting, and authentication details before asking for implementation.
Ask for tests, validation rules, and error states with each generated feature.
Review generated migrations, secrets, and deployment steps before running them.
anti_patterns: Requesting production-ready code without sharing constraints, data model, or security requirements.
Running generated setup or migration commands without reviewing project impact.
Mixing unrelated frontend, backend, and deployment changes in one vague request.

faq.question: Can this skill build complete applications?
faq.answer: It can guide application structure and feature implementation, but the agent still needs repository context and verification.

faq.question: Does it support TypeScript?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill focuses on modern JavaScript and TypeScript stacks for frontend and backend work.

faq.question: Can it work with SQL and NoSQL databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, and related data modeling choices.

faq.question: Will it deploy my application automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can provide deployment guidance, but actual deployment depends on agent permissions and your environment.

faq.question: Is generated code secure by default?
faq.answer: No generated code is guaranteed secure. Review validation, authentication, secrets, and database changes before use.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
